hero.heading:
Saint Maron
Maronite Catholic Church
hero.lede:
One of the first Maronite parishes in North America, Saint Maron Church has faithfully served the faithful in South Philadelphia since 1892. For generations, our parish has been a home of prayer, worship, and communion, preserving and sharing the rich spiritual heritage of the Maronite Catholic Church.

On Saturday, December 2, 2017, we gave thanks to God as we celebrated the 125th anniversary of our parish. We remember with gratitude all those who, through their faith, sacrifice, and devotion, helped build the parish we cherish today.

Rooted in the faith of our fathers and strengthened by the grace of God, Saint Maron continues its mission of proclaiming the Gospel and celebrating the Sacred Mysteries. All are welcome at the Table of the Lord.

parish.story: Founded by Lebanese immigrants at the close of the nineteenth century, Saint Maron has been a spiritual home for generations of families in South Philadelphia. We worship in the ancient Maronite tradition — one of the Eastern Catholic Churches in full communion with Rome — with a liturgy whose roots reach back to the earliest Christian communities of Antioch.
parish.storyMore: Whether your family has been here for a hundred years or you are stepping inside for the first time, you belong here.
